mapper.update: MERGE INTO MB_DEVICE_TOKEN target USING (SELECT #{adminId} AS ADMIN_ID, #{pushToken} AS PUSH_TOKEN, #{platform} AS PLATFORM FROM DUAL) source ON (target.PUSH_TOKEN = source.PUSH_TOKEN) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.ADMIN_ID = source.ADMIN_ID, target.PLATFORM = source.PLATFORM, target.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ADMIN_ID, PUSH_TOKEN, PLATFORM) VALUES (source.ADMIN_ID, source.PUSH_TOKEN, source.PLATFORM)
